Below is a quick summary focused on downgrade/rollback and a pilot-friendly grace window: 

Summary: downgrade/rollback basics
- Tier swaps: Can be performed at any time. Upgrades are immediate; downgrades require a 30-day notice to avoid abrupt capacity evaporation for stateful private deployments.
- Financials: Upgrades billed pro rata from the change date. Downgrades produce a prorated account credit applied to the next billing cycle (not a refund).
- Grace period: For pilots we typically recommend a 60-day observation/rollback window with one-time seat-crediting for accidental overprovisioning (subject to approval).
- Automated fallback: We offer policy-driven routing so you can route traffic back to the previous model/tier automatically on quality or latency regressions. This is configurable via the Console and can be part of the rollout policy.

Hi Liam — quick technical follow-up and a small worked example attached (PlanComparison.xlsx and usage_projection.xlsx). A few operational notes that often help procurement and infra teams: 

Operational notes
- Downgrade mechanics for Hosted vs Dedicated: Hosted (our multi-tenant API) can scale down immediately at the billing boundary; Dedicated pools may take up to 48 hours to drain depending on running jobs and in-flight KV caches. We surface this in the Console during change requests.
- Seat-crediting: For pilot customers we allow a one-time seat-credit up to 20% of committed seats if overprovisioning occurs in the first 60 days. Extra usage beyond that is billed at standard overage rates.
- Feature bundles: Observability retention and model caching are add-ons that can be toggled independently and have different downgrade rules (retention has a 30-day lag for hard deletes).
- Example scenario (from PlanComparison.xlsx):
  - Start Compact (50 seats) at $X/month. Upgrade to Standard (200 seats) mid-quarter -> prorated charge for the upgrade + credit for unused Compact seats applied to next invoice.
  - If you downgrade back within the 60-day window we waive a one-time downgrade fee and apply seat credits to cover up to 20% of seats you previously committed.
